t: 克吕格可汗被封为蒙古人克哈干和元朝的武宗.
te: Külüg Khan is enthroned as Khagan of the Mongols and Wuzong of the Yuan.
dz: 克吕格可汗被封为蒙古人克哈干和元朝的武宗.
de: Külüg Khan is enthroned as Khagan of the Mongols and Wuzong of the Yuan.

t: 法国有上百名圣殿骑士在黎明被国王腓特烈·博览会逮捕,后被以酷刑逼供于异端.
te: Hundreds of the Knights Templar in France are arrested at dawn by King Philip the Fair, and later confess under torture…
dz: 法国有上百名圣殿骑士在黎明被国王腓特烈·博览会逮捕,后被以酷刑逼供于异端.
de: Hundreds of the Knights Templar in France are arrested at dawn by King Philip the Fair, and later confess under torture to heresy.

t: 圣殿骑士军官Hugues de Pairaud在圣殿骑士审判期间被迫认罪. 他被以虚假偶像主义…
te: Knights Templar officer Hugues de Pairaud is forced to confess during the Trials of the Knights Templar. He was persecu…
dz: 圣殿骑士军官Hugues de Pairaud在圣殿骑士审判期间被迫认罪. 他被以虚假偶像主义和鸡奸罪名被迫害.
de: Knights Templar officer Hugues de Pairaud is forced to confess during the Trials of the Knights Templar. He was persecuted on the charges of false idolism and sodomy.

t: 教皇克莱门特五世颁布了教皇训令 Pastoralis Praeeminentiae，指示欧洲所…
te: Pope Clement V issues the papal bull Pastoralis Praeeminentiae which instructed all Christian monarchs in Europe to arr…
dz: 教皇克莱门特五世颁布了教皇训令 Pastoralis Praeeminentiae，指示欧洲所有基督教君主逮捕所有圣殿骑士并没收他们的资产。
de: Pope Clement V issues the papal bull Pastoralis Praeeminentiae which instructed all Christian monarchs in Europe to arrest all Templars and seize their assets.
